Zone 1 analysis is consistent, but we must confirm the global minimum across all zones. I'll compute the ratio for the entire dataset and find the overall minimum.

```python
# Clean full dataset: exclude rows where Revenue or Rent is NaN
full_clean = df.dropna(subset=['Revenue','Rent']).copy()
full_clean['Revenue_to_Rent'] = full_clean['Revenue'] / full_clean['Rent']
min_global = full_clean['Revenue_to_Rent'].min()
global_min = full_clean.loc[full_clean['Revenue_to_Rent'] == min_global]
print(global_min[['Name','Type','Revenue','Rent','Revenue_to_Rent']])
```
